messages:
elyse: PSA — tiny yellow sticky on my monitor that says 'Take the left donut'. Who's trolling the kitchen? :doughnut:

omar: that's the Sticky Note Goblin. last seen near the Keurig. :eyes:

tess: omg it's back. we thought it left after the Great Labeling Incident of '22

devon: i confess. ran out of labels, made an emergency sticky oracle. it claimed the left donut. took the left donut. no regrets. :sunglasses:

elyse: devon!! return the right donut immediately :pleading_face:

tess: petition to make the Goblin an honorary snack czar. who votes yes?

maple-bot: poll created — "Make the Sticky Note Goblin official?" — votes: yes (3), no (0) :trophy:

niko: also found a sticky under the ficus that says 'Meeting moved to nap time' — who thinks the Goblin is trying to start a union? :laughing:

omar: when in doubt, leave an offering of post-its and coffee. the Goblin respects ritual.

devon: new tradition: every Friday bring one novelty sticky and a story. title suggestions? 'Sticky Stories' 'Goblin Lore Hour' 'Post-It Pilgrimage'

tess: 'Post-It Pilgrimage' is peak Redwood folklore.

elyse: i'll add it to the whiteboard. if anyone wants to volunteer to be the Goblin's scribe, sign up on the sticky next to the snacks. :memo:

omar: concluding note — if you find a sticky directing you to take someone's lunch, that's a felony. probably.

elyse: thanks for the chaos. :heart:
